title: Businessman murder: ‘Killer bahu’, hubby made 330 calls to ex-servant in 21 days

Investigators found evidence of a three-month planning period for the alleged murder.  The duo reportedly entered the victim's flat disguised as delivery personnel.  CCTV footage and call records aided police in reconstructing the conspiracy.

title: Delhi building collapse: Can a 'no-responsibility' clause shield a PG owner?

Legal experts state that such clauses cannot permit conduct violating legal duties.  Families of victims can still seek compensation if negligence and causation are proven.  Investigations will determine the ultimate responsibility of owners and authorities involved.

All devices run on the powerful A20 Pro chip and offer eSIM-only functionality.  Pre-orders and availability dates for India have been announced for these new iPhones.

title: Team India absence can't slow Mohammed Shami down: ‘Eyes always on next level’

He emphasises the importance of self-motivation at this level, striving to seize every chance to contribute to his team’s success. The pacer emphasises hard work as his foundation, trusting that fate will take care of the rest.

title: How BJP, Congress turned 80s AI trend turned into an all-out meme war

This trend has quickly morphed into a creative form of political satire, with the BJP and Congress leveraging it to exchange jabs. Leaders like Piyush Goyal and Kiren Rijiju are riding the retro wave, and even Rahul Gandhi has joined the fray with quirky AI-generated images.

title: Govt tightens e-commerce rules to curb price manipulation, dark patterns: What changes?
content: Effective January 2027, upcoming e-commerce rules aim to bolster consumer safeguards by requiring platforms to exhibit previous pricing clearly and avoid search result manipulation. There will be mandatory disclosures for sponsored listings to assist consumers in their choices. Furthermore, e-commerce companies will need to manage customer grievances effectively and work with the National Consumer Helpline, along with stricter regulations concerning data usage, imported items, and fee bundling.

title: Cristiano Ronaldo vs Travis Kelce net worth: The staggering $1.11 billion gap
content: Cristiano Ronaldo's impressive wealth of $1.2 billion dwarfs Travis Kelce's $90 million fortune. This staggering sum is primarily due to his rich contract with Al Nassr and a plethora of global business endeavors. Kelce, on the other hand, generates income from his NFL career, endorsements, and the success of his podcast 'New Heights'. With his recent relationship with Taylor Swift, his marketability has soared, leading to numerous new opportunities.

title: 1980s AI Photo trend: 5 ChatGPT prompts to create Kerala-style retro images
content: A social media trend uses ChatGPT to recreate photos in 1980s styles. Users are now focusing on regional aesthetics, specifically 1980s Kerala and Malayali culture. Prompts request authentic family, wedding, college, and studio portraits from the period. These images incorporate traditional clothing, jewellery, and home settings from Kerala. The AI maintains recognizable facial features while adding retro photographic elements.

title: 15-year-old found alive on overturned fishing boat after going missing off Alaska
content: A 15-year-old boy was rescued after being found clinging to an overturned 18-foot fishing boat about four miles east of St. Lawrence Island, Alaska. The Coast Guard had launched a search for three missing boaters after the vessel failed to return. Two other boaters were found dead in the water and taken to Nome with the survivor.

title: 22-year-old pleads guilty in US' biggest Bitcoin theft; spent millions on cars & more
content: A 22-year-old organized a scheme stealing over 4,100 Bitcoin from an investor.  The stolen cryptocurrency was then spent on luxury items and lavish experiences.  Investigators traced the digital trail through a missed IP address, leading to arrests.  Several defendants have pleaded guilty, and others are awaiting sentencing in the ongoing case.  This incident highlights the growing threat of social engineering in cryptocurrency fraud.

title: Failed farm cut 50 miles of ditches; scientists now plan to reflood peatland
content: In a significant ecological effort, North Carolina is working to restore its ancient peatlands that suffered damage from farming practices impacting their carbon storage capabilities. The previous drainage systems caused water levels to drop, resulting in peat exposure to air and increased emissions. Restoration efforts include blocking these ditches to enhance land rehydration and restore the water table.

title: Sent home by PCB, Rizwan and Imam summoned by Pakistan's national cyber crime agency

This inquiry comes shortly after their return from a disappointing series defeat. The agency plans to analyze data from their mobile phones, previously secured by the Pakistan Cricket Board.

title: Taylor Swift fan helps discover 12 insect species, names 4 after singer and albums
content: A new genus of Australian insects has been named Swiftiephylus after singer Taylor Swift.  Four new species within this genus also bear names inspired by her music.  These pale yellow and cream-colored insects were collected between 1995 and 2004.  Their discovery highlights the vast undocumented insect diversity remaining globally.  This naming brings attention to insect conservation and scientific discovery.

title: Tax startup CEO allegedly faked credentials to raise $13.3 million from investors

She is accused of swindling over $13 million from venture capital funds by falsely portraying herself as a licensed CPA while fabricating revenue reports. It is alleged that the funds were misappropriated for personal luxuries, including an extravagant wedding, leaving investors with substantial financial setbacks after her company's abrupt downfall.

title: Companies turning interns into full-time hires; what it means for IT sector jobs
content: For students who are entering the job market, an internship is no longer just a line on their resume. It can be the first real test of whether a company sees them as a potential full-time employee.

title: Same height, similar age, different paths: Zverev & Khachanov eye US Open final
content: The stage is set for an exhilarating US Open semi-final as Alexander Zverev clashes with Karen Khachanov. Zverev, bolstered by his Grand Slam experience, holds the top seed rank, while Khachanov looks to capitalise on his unseeded status to secure his first final appearance. Both athletes bring formidable serves and robust baseline tactics, ensuring an electrifying battle is on the horizon.

title: No 'Nitishpur'? JD(U) sidesteps NDA partner's proposal to rename Nitish's birthplace

They asserted that the town’s historical essence remains intact, regardless of its name. Meanwhile, the idea was met with mockery from the RJD, illustrating the ongoing political debate surrounding historical perceptions and the lasting impact of influential figures in society.

title: Giant reed brought to California now doubles or triples wildfire fuel
content: Giant reed, a plant native to eastern Asia, was introduced to California in the 1820s for roofing material and erosion control. It has since become an invasive weed, growing rapidly and forming dense stands that displace native plants. In Southern California’s Santa Ana River Basin, arundo infestations have almost tripled fire fuel loads and also increased pressure on water resources.

title: West Virginia’s restored elk herd is finally roaming farther again
content: West Virginia's elk restoration initiative is flourishing, with the herd expanding to around 130 individuals alongside numerous native calves. Elk are venturing into new territories, showcasing a robust population increase. This revival not only highlights the animals' successful reintroduction into their habitat but also boosts local tourism, marking a remarkable triumph in wildlife conservation.

title: Mayawati's fifth-term UP bet: How Akash Anand's missed X repost sealed his fate in BSP

Additionally, the BCCI has played down any speculation surrounding his future, with Rohit mentioning that a bus parade celebration could be out of the question.

title: 52-year-old idea turns Australian bridge into wildlife corridor over motorway
content: An innovative wildlife crossing, born from an Australian park ranger's fifty-two-year-old vision, has finally been realized. Cawleys Bridge has been modified to facilitate safe passage for important wildlife across a bustling motorway. This enhancement allows species like koalas to navigate between vital habitats such as Heathcote National Park and Garrawarra State Conservation Area. Future wildlife monitoring will assess usage patterns and guide subsequent conservation projects.

title: Idaho bridge sat unused for 56 years; now it is a wildlife crossing
content: An abandoned bridge over Interstate 90 in Osburn, Idaho, was repurposed as a wildlife crossing. This initiative was championed by a local truck driver who witnessed numerous animal collisions. Conservation groups and state officials collaborated to transform the unused structure into a safe passage. Trail cameras confirmed deer regularly using the bridge, avoiding the dangerous interstate. The bridge, though temporary, successfully provided a vital crossing for animals.

title: Hawaii’s 9-foot invasive grass can produce 9,000 seeds per plant and fuel fires
content: Once celebrated for its grazing benefits, Guinea grass has become a formidable threat to Hawaii's delicate ecosystems. Since its introduction in the 19th century, it has proliferated, reaching impressive heights. This resilient perennial can generate thousands of seeds and rebound swiftly from fires, exacerbating wildfire risks by providing ample fuel across the islands. Its growth pattern serves as a stark reminder of the lasting ecological impact of imported plant species.

title: Space-based surveillance: Dhruva to get key systems worth €5m from Safran
content: satellites will be built as part of India's space-based Surveillance-3 (SBS-3) programme . the contracts, signed during the international space summit in Paris, cover communication systems, inertial navigation units, optical payloads and ground stations .

title: 17-year-old turns cancer treatment decisions into a 72-card game for students
content: a deck of 72 cards sits on a desk, each representing a different cancer treatment option, side effect or patient factor . the game was designed to help young patients and their families visualise complex treatment decisions, turning abstract medical information into something they can hold, sort and discuss . it creator is 17-year-old student and cancer researcher .

title: At least 20 killed in cargo ship fire at China’s Qingdao port - all you need to know
content: a foreign cargo ship caught fire during its port call for maintenance, causing heavy casualties . the fire erupted at around 11:15 am local time, state media reports . china's president calls for an urgent search for missing people .

title: 'Can't browbeat child': SC on CJP protester's intimidation complaint against 'influencer'
content: a 14-year-old girl associated with the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) protests was harassed . she was subjected to stone pelting, directing authorities to act on her FIR . the court stressed that nobody could be allowed to intimidate a victim or her family .

title: Gujarat man pleads guilty in US in $9.36 million illegal gambling case
content: an Indian national of Gujarati origin has pleaded guilty to his role in a multi-million-dollar illegal gambling conspiracy . he allegedly operated through six businesses in southwest Missouri, generating nearly USD 9.36 million (approximately Rs 89 crore) in gross proceeds .

title: iPhone 18 Pro, Pro Max launched: Check prices in US, UK, Dubai, Canada and more
content: the iphone 18 Pro and the iPhone 18 Pro Max start at $1,199 . in india, the two models start at Rs 1,64,900 and Rs 1,79,900 respectively . prices vary across international markets, with prices fluctuating .

title: ‘Get off our roads, Mr Singh’: US govt poster ignites backlash over targeting of Sikhs
content: the poster was shared by US DHS on its X account toi . the post is part of the Trump administration’s broader campaign against immigrants working as commercial drivers . but the choice of a common Indian surname has triggered a backlash among Sikh, Hindu, Punjabi American and immigrant organizations .

title: Ladakh groups disappointed over MHA meet; Wangchuk warns of fresh stir from Sept 19
content: LAB member Sonam Wangchuk said there had been "no special progress" since the meeting . a delegation had come to Delhi expecting a draft detailing the structure and powers of the proposed body . the LAB and KDA have been seeking an elected legislative body at the UT level .

title: China confirms Xi's India visit for Brics summit on Sept 12-13, first trip in 7 years
content: Xi will attend the 18th Brics summit in new Delhi from september 12 to 13 . this is his first trip to India in seven years and comes as the two countries work to stabilise ties after years of tensions over their disputed border . he will be attending with a large delegation, more than double the Chinese contingent that accompanied him on his last India visit in 2019 .

title: Newport mansion revives 1500s staircase craft with mortise-and-wedge joinery
content: the technique originated in the construction of European staircases in the late 1500s . a stairway goes up to nowhere in a woodshop . it is a revival of a late 16th century European method of building stairs . the technique uses modern computer modeling and manufacturing technology to achieve accurate results .
